title: Options snapshot: the keyless Cboe delayed-quotes source (adds open interest + volume) is blocked from every machine we run. cdn.cboe.com now 307-redirects to cdn-api.cboe.com, which serves a Cloudflare 'Sorry, you have been blocked' page (HTTP 403) to GitHub runners, the trainer VM and cloud session containers. The Alpaca (keyed) half still captures all 55 underlyings, so only OI and volume stop. Options: (A, preferred) take OI from Alpaca's own option contracts endpoint (open_interest + open_interest_date) and daily volume from Alpaca option bars, same key, no new source; (B) IB market data (OI via generic tick) through the gateway; (C) retire the Cboe half as a recorded 'shadowed' data feature if OI/volume have no consumer. Off the trade path, ON the data path: the freshness check must keep flagging, never read the gap as 'no data'.
note:

Take OI and volume from Alpaca (option contracts open_interest, option bars volume): same key, no new source. BEFORE building, check who consumes the Cboe OI and volume today. If nothing does, A still applies, recorded as shadowed WITH its freshness check (docs/reference/shadowed-features.yaml). Off the trade path is not off the data path, so option C is never 'drop it'.
